name: Niszczyciel załóg (galera łuczników, z generatora gry)
description: An Aegean galley of the 12th century BC built for archers: pitch-black hull with a red ochre wale and a white zigzag, one bank of seven oars a side, raised platforms fore and aft with archers' stands, a crow's nest, a wooden spur at the forefoot and a brailed square sail.
